description: Retries one of our texts that failed to send (delivery_status 'failed'), as the same message, on your person's order. A text marked 'undelivered' was refused for good and cannot be retried: send a new text instead. Read the message first and pass its exact to (phone_to) and body. First call without confirm_token: nothing is sent; you get a preview and a confirm_token. Show your person the preview word for word, and only after they say yes, call again with the same arguments and the SAME idempotency_key, plus confirm_token.

confirm_token.description: From the preview, after your person said yes. Leave it out to get the preview.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: retry_text
title: Retry a text that failed to send (after your person confirms)
